title: Mulligan will dub me a new name: the bullockbefriending bard.
html_source: Stephen portrays himself in terms of how another will portray him, an undercurrent in the novel which continues throughout especially with the character Molly who is described in terms of how others see her in chapters 4-17 until she takes over in the final chapter.
